rows.note: This is the all-purpose abstract noun for the characteristic of being ordinary or unremarkable, especially in formal or written discussion.

example.english: The novel’s depiction of the mundanity of urban life is surprisingly striking.
example.traditional: 呢部小說對都市生活平凡性的描寫，反而令人印象深刻。
